```{r}
# Factor CMVIgG negative
data$CMVIgG_negative = as.factor(data$CMVIgG_negative)

# Center and Scale continuous clinical variables

                                where(is.numeric),
                              ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))))
```

# Prep Datasets/ Covariates 

```{r}
### Pain Int
data_ltc_pi = data %>% filter(!is.na(IFNy)) %>% 
  select(subject_id, pi_traj_cont, gait_speed:emotional_support_tscore, IFNy:CMVIgG_negative,
                                  -spef_diab)
data_ltc_pi_bm = data_ltc_pi %>% select(IFNy:CMVIgG_negative)
data_ltc_pi = data_ltc_pi %>% select(-(IFNy:CMVIgG_negative))

```

# Make Function for Covariate Matrix 

```{r}
make_group_matrix <- function(data,
                                 response,
                                 # Factors
                                 na_as_level = TRUE,
                                 na_level    = "(Missing)",
                                 # Numeric preprocessing
                                 center = TRUE,
                                 scale  = TRUE,
                                 indicator_suffix = "_miss") {
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(data))
  stopifnot(is.character(response), length(response) == 1, response %in% names(data))

  impute_numeric <- "mean"

  # Work on a copy
  df <- data

  # Extract outcome and remove from predictors
  y <- df[[response]]
  df[[response]] <- NULL

  # ----- A) Factors: coerce and (optionally) add explicit missing level -----
  for (nm in names(df)) {
    if (is.character(df[[nm]])) df[[nm]] <- factor(df[[nm]])
    if (is.factor(df[[nm]]) && isTRUE(na_as_level)) {
      df[[nm]] <- addNA(df[[nm]])
      lev <- levels(df[[nm]])
      lev[is.na(lev)] <- na_level
      levels(df[[nm]]) <- lev
    }
  }

  # ----- B) Numeric main effects: indicators + impute + center/scale -----
  cont_vars <- names(df)[vapply(df, function(z) is.numeric(z) && !is.factor(z), logical(1))]
  miss_indicator_cols <- list()
  preproc <- list(
    numeric = list(stats = list(),
                   method = impute_numeric,
                   center = center,
                   scale  = scale),
    factor  = list(na_as_level = na_as_level, na_level = na_level)
  )

  for (v in cont_vars) {
    xvec <- df[[v]]
    # 0/1 missingness indicator (kept even if there are no NAs; it's all zeros then)
    miss_indicator_cols[[v]] <- as.integer(is.na(xvec))

    # Impute
    fill <- switch(impute_numeric,
                   mean   = mean(xvec, na.rm = TRUE),
                   median = stats::median(xvec, na.rm = TRUE),
                   zero   = 0)
    x_imp <- xvec
    x_imp[is.na(x_imp)] <- fill

    # Center/scale
    mu  <- if (center) mean(x_imp) else 0
    sdv <- if (scale)  stats::sd(x_imp) else 1
    if (isTRUE(scale) && (is.na(sdv) || sdv == 0)) sdv <- 1

    df[[v]] <- if (!center && !scale) x_imp else (x_imp - mu) / sdv

    # Record stats for reproducibility
    preproc$numeric$stats[[v]] <- list(impute_value = fill, mean = mu, sd = sdv)
  }

  # ----- C) Build model matrix (capture ASSIGN BEFORE subsetting!) -----
  tt <- terms(~ ., data = df)
  mf <- model.frame(tt, data = df, na.action = na.pass)

  X_full <- model.matrix(tt, data = mf)   # includes intercept if any
  assign_full <- attr(X_full, "assign")   # capture before any subsetting
  if (is.null(assign_full)) {
    stop("Internal error: attr(X_full, 'assign') is NULL; model.matrix did not supply 'assign'.")
  }

  # Drop intercept column and its assign entry if present
  has_intercept <- isTRUE(attr(tt, "intercept") == 1)
  if (has_intercept) {
    # Intercept is column 1 in model.matrix output
    X0 <- X_full[, -1, drop = FALSE]
    assign_vec <- assign_full[-1]
  } else {
    X0 <- X_full
    assign_vec <- assign_full
  }
  
  
  # Term labels (one per model term; often equals unique(assign_vec))
  term.labels <- attr(tt, "term.labels")

  # Start from base matrix and grouping
  X     <- X0
  group <- assign_vec
  
    # ----- D) Append numeric missing indicators, grouped with their main-effect term -----
  if (length(miss_indicator_cols)) {
    for (v in names(miss_indicator_cols)) {
      # Find the *term id* for this variable in the ~ . design
      term_id <- match(v, term.labels)
      if (is.na(term_id)) next  # defensive; should not happen in ~ . design

      ind_name <- paste0(v, indicator_suffix)
      ind_vec  <- as.numeric(miss_indicator_cols[[v]])

      # Append as a *matrix* column to keep X as matrix
      ind_mat <- matrix(ind_vec, nrow = nrow(X), ncol = 1,
                        dimnames = list(NULL, ind_name))
      X <- cbind(X, ind_mat)

      # Append exactly one group id for the new column
      group <- c(group, term_id)
    }
  }
  
    # Ensure unique, clean column names
  colnames(X) <- make.unique(colnames(X), sep = "_dup")

  # Final integrity checks
  if (ncol(X) != length(group)) {
    stop(sprintf("Length mismatch: ncol(X) = %d but length(group) = %d",
                 ncol(X), length(group)))
  }


  list(X = X, y = y)
}


```



# Pain Int

```{r}
### Create Model Matrix 
mm_pi <- make_group_matrix(
  data         = data_ltc_pi[,-1],            # your data.frame
  response  = "pi_traj_cont", # outcome column name in df
  center = FALSE, 
  scale = FALSE
)

mm_pi$X = cbind(mm_pi$X, data_ltc_pi_bm)
mm_pi$X$CMVIgG_negative = as.numeric(mm_pi$X$CMVIgG_negative)-1
mm_pi$X <- mm_pi$X[, colSums(mm_pi$X != 0) > 0]


  #### Complementary Pairs Stability Selection 
results_cpss_pi = list()
for(q in seq(5, 25, 5)){
  set.seed(339580)
  temp = stabsel(x = mm_pi$X, 
               y = mm_pi$y, 
               fitfun = glmnet.lasso, 
               q = q, 
               PFER = 2, 
               B = 100)
  results_cpss_pi[[paste0("q", q, "_cpss")]] = temp$max
}
combined_cpss_pi <- as.data.frame(do.call(cbind, results_cpss_pi))

combined_cpss_pi$predictor = rownames(combined_cpss_pi)

combined_cpss_pi <- combined_cpss_pi %>%
  mutate(q5_cpss_ranked = rank(-q5_cpss) %>% as.integer(), 
         q10_cpss_ranked = rank(-q10_cpss) %>% as.integer(),
         q15_cpss_ranked = rank(-q15_cpss) %>% as.integer(),
         q20_cpss_ranked = rank(-q20_cpss) %>% as.integer(),
         q25_cpss_ranked = rank(-q25_cpss) %>% as.integer())

#### Bootstrap LASSO
#perform k-fold cross-validation to find optimal lambda value
cv_model <- cv.glmnet(mm_pi$X,
                      mm_pi$y, 
                      alpha = 1,
                      type.measure = "mse",
                      nfolds = nrow(data_ltc_pi))

#
zeros = cv_model$nzero
lambdas = c(cv_model$lambda[which.max(zeros[zeros <= 5])], 
            cv_model$lambda[which.max(zeros[zeros <= 10])], 
            cv_model$lambda[which.max(zeros[zeros <= 15])], 
            cv_model$lambda[which.max(zeros[zeros <= 20])], 
            cv_model$lambda[which.max(zeros[zeros <= 25])]
)

results_boot_pi = list(q5_boot = c(), q10_boot = c(), q15_boot = c(), 
                           q20_boot = c(), q25_boot = c())
for(B in 1:200){
  set.seed(B*12098)
  indices = sample(nrow(data_ltc_pi), 
                   nrow(data_ltc_pi), 
                   replace = TRUE)
  boot_pi_X = mm_pi$X[indices,]
  boot_pi_y = mm_pi$y[indices]
  final_model = glmnet(boot_pi_X, 
                     boot_pi_y,
                     alpha = 1,
                     lambda = lambdas)
  for(i in 1:length(lambdas)){
      results_boot_pi[[i]] = c(results_boot_pi[[i]],rownames(coef(final_model, 
                                            s = lambdas[i]))[coef(final_model, 
                                                                  s = lambdas[i])[, 1] != 0][-1])
  }
}

for(name in names(results_boot_pi)){
  results_boot_pi[[name]] = data.frame(
  table(results_boot_pi[[name]])/200
) %>% arrange(-Freq)
colnames(results_boot_pi[[name]]) <- c("predictor", name)
}

combined_boot_pi <- Reduce(function(x,y)
  full_join(x, y, by = "predictor"), results_boot_pi) %>% 
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(., 0))) %>% 
  mutate(q5_boot_ranked = rank(-q5_boot, na.last = "keep") %>% as.integer(), 
         q10_boot_ranked = rank(-q10_boot, na.last = "keep") %>% as.integer(),
         q15_boot_ranked = rank(-q15_boot, na.last = "keep") %>% as.integer(),
         q20_boot_ranked = rank(-q20_boot, na.last = "keep") %>% as.integer(),
         q25_boot_ranked = rank(-q25_boot, na.last = "keep") %>% as.integer())

#### Combining Results 
combined_cpss_pi$predictor = str_replace_all(combined_cpss_pi$predictor, 
                                             "`", "")
combined_pi = full_join(combined_cpss_pi, 
                            combined_boot_pi, 
                            by = "predictor")
combined_pi <- combined_pi %>% 
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & ends_with("ranked"), ~ replace_na(., 30))) %>% 
   mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & ends_with("boot"), ~ replace_na(., 0)))

top10_pi_binary = combined_pi %>% select(ends_with("ranked")) %>% apply(2, function(x) ifelse(x <= 10, 1, 0))
rownames(top10_pi_binary) = combined_pi$predictor

rowSums_top10_pi_binary = rowSums(top10_pi_binary) %>% sort(decreasing = TRUE) 

results_sp_pi = data.frame(predictor = names(rowSums_top10_pi_binary), 
           stabscore = unname(rowSums_top10_pi_binary)) %>% left_join(
             combined_pi, by = "predictor"
           ) %>% rowwise %>% mutate(
    median_sp = median(c_across(matches("^q(5|10|15|20|25)_(cpss|boot)$")))) %>% ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(-stabscore, -median_sp) %>% 
  filter(stabscore != 0) %>% 
  mutate(health_measure = "pi")
```
